This post will explore how to leverage these tools to sell design assets with crypto payments, ensuring creators retain more of their earnings while enjoying full ownership of their digital storefronts.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-8. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments means utilizing a decentralized payment system that allows creators to collect payments directly without intermediary platforms. This is crucial for creators in regions where conventional payment processors either charge exorbitant fees or are completely unavailable. For instance, platforms like Gumroad charge 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only charges a mere 0.5%. This difference in fees can significantly impact your earnings. If you sell 100 products per month at $97 each, the fee difference retains an impressive $921 in your pocket, highlighting the importance of choosing the right payment method.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling design assets with crypto payments involves several components working seamlessly together. At the core, you can utilize GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital storefront. This allows for the free and reliable delivery of your products. Backend logic can be handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring automated processes like order management and payment verification. For storage, platforms like Supabase or Google Sheets can keep track of your orders. Finally, NOWPayments facilitates the actual crypto transactions, providing a smooth and efficient checkout experience without the need for buyer accounts or KYC verification.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries facing payment processing challenges, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela. These creators often sell various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. By adopting this sovereign commerce stack, they can bypass the limitations imposed by conventional platforms, effectively monetizing their work without losing a significant portion of their earnings to fees. This system empowers creators to build a self-sufficient online store where they maintain complete ownership and control over their products and customer data, fostering a sustainable income stream.
Retain more of your earnings by leveraging low-fee crypto payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively sell design assets using this architecture, several key components must work together. Starting with hosting, you can utilize free services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to establish a digital storefront. Your backend logic will be powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which will automate processes such as payment confirmation and product delivery. For order management, Supabase or Google Sheets can be employed to store and manage customer orders efficiently. The final piece of the puzzle is NOWPayments, which enables seamless cryptocurrency transactions with low fees and instant payment verification. Together, these elements create a robust system for selling digital products directly to customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with selling your design assets through this infrastructure, follow these steps: First, choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to set up your digital storefront. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing and delivery automation. Create an order management system using Supabase or Google Sheets to keep track of sales. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept payments in various digital currencies. Finally, fine-tune your store with the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment process.
